method.bodyRule: largest connected component with B-R >= 35, B-G >= 15, B >= 80; alpha >= 32
method.units: pixels in each atlas cellSize; belowFeet = cellSize - 1 - last body row
method.caveat: Blue-body silhouette estimate; excludes detached props. Alpha bounds include all props. Not a mouth/rig anchor. Optical-flow edges and highlights can shift the estimate.
